risks.risk: Edition mismatch (could be Xbox One S with disc drive, or another Xbox model). Photos don’t show the model/label or disc-drive area.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console’s rear label/model number and a photo of the front disc slot area (or confirmation that there is no disc slot).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case for the buyer: treat as not confirmed disc-free/edition unknown (value lower than confirmed Xbox One S All-Digital).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (no power-on test shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the console powering on to the dashboard (or showing error-free boot) plus a screenshot/photo of system settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until proven working.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI, controller, etc.)—not shown.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item (power brick/cable, HDMI, controller, headset, original box if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/unknown bundle (only the console), with missing accessories treated as not included.

risks.risk: Storage/account status unknown (could be wiped, banned account, or storage issues).
risks.proof: Photo/video of storage capacity shown in settings and confirmation of sign-in state (e.g., no active locked/banned account).
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown storage and no guarantees on account status.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rear label showing exact model/edition (and serial if possible).
Photo of the front area showing whether there is a disc slot (or clear proof it’s disc-free).
Power-on video to the dashboard (or system settings) showing it boots normally.
Photos of all included accessories laid out (controller, HDMI, power cable/brick, etc.).
response.reason: From the photos, the console type is only roughly identifiable (Xbox-style front grille), but the exact Xbox One S All-Digital edition and working condition are not verifiable. To price safely, you need the model/edition label and a power-on proof.
